summary: Enhance your data skills with our Power BI training course. Learn to analyze and visualize data effectively, transforming insights into impactful decisions.
lede: Power BI data analysis training covers the reporting workflow for analysts and other professionals who prepare, build, or review recurring business reports. It includes cleaning data with Power Query, modelling relationships and writing DAX measures, then designing visuals, checking results against source totals, and publishing reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who create, review, or use Power BI reports and need a foundation-to-intermediate grasp of the full reporting workflow. It suits professionals who can work with structured business data but want guided practice with modelling, DAX, visual design, and publication.
modules: Power BI Analysis and Reporting Capstone
prerequisites: You should be comfortable working with tables, filters, formulas, and basic business metrics. No coding or database administration background is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets, CSV files, or organizational reporting processes will help you complete the exercises more efficiently. Advanced DAX optimization, enterprise deployment pipelines, and production data engineering remain outside the hands-on scope of this foundation-to-intermediate course.
